data.one_liner: A simple lightweight and customizable version update library for Flutter
data.what_it_does: It provides a mechanism to check, download, and install application updates on Android and iOS devices. It supports custom update models, download progress listeners, and handling release downloads.
use_when: You need to handle in-app version updates and APK downloads for Android
You need to redirect users to iOS App Store updates
avoid_when: Your app is solely distributed via official stores that handle automatic updates natively without custom flows
You do not target Android or iOS
strengths: Supports update progress listening and custom notification handling
Maintains cross-platform consistency between Android and iOS update logic
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup and configuration for downloading and installing APKs on Android
Limited documentation outside of basic usage snippets
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package dependency to pubspec.yaml and configuring an UpdateModel with the app update URL.
